nodes.description: Owner address state variable inherited by ShyftKycContract, set to msg.sender in the ShyftKycContract constructor and used to gate privileged functions.
Address of the external Ferrum bot-protection contract that is invoked with a low-level call from the checkBots modifier.
Cached Uniswap V2 pair address computed in the constructor by pairFor(wETH, address(this)).
Public balances mapping of the SHFT token; mutated with unchecked += and -= arithmetic.
Public nested allowance mapping; set to uint(-1) in the constructor and modified by approve/transferFrom.
Total token supply, initialized to 0 and used in list() distribution arithmetic totalSupply * 6 / 100.
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router interface instance used for addLiquidityETH in list().
Hardcoded WETH address used with address(this) to derive the Uniswap pair.
Constant token decimals value (18).
Token name string 'Shyft [ Byfrost ]'.
Token symbol string 'SHFT'.
Private ERC20 balance mapping updated by the internal _transfer helper.
Private ERC20 nested allowance mapping updated by the internal _approve helper.
Private ERC20 total supply updated by _mint and _burn.
Constructor of BotProtected that stores the supplied bot-protection address into the botProtection state variable.
Modifier that performs an unchecked low-level call into botProtection with selector 0x15274141 before the guarded function body runs.
Constructor that sets owner = msg.sender, derives uniPair via pairFor, and grants unlimited allowances to the router and the pair.
Payable transfer entry point that simply delegates to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
Payable transfer guarded by the checkBots modifier; performs unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic and emits Transfer.
Payable approve function that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly without zeroing and emits Approval.
Owner-only function that performs an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-controllable address a with arbitrary calldata b.
Deterministic CREATE2 pair-address derivation for the Uniswap V2 factory using token ordering.
Owner-only liquidity listing function that writes balances, calls addLiquidityETH with a timestamp deadline and loops over recipient/amount arrays.
Internal ERC20 transfer helper using SafeMath sub/add on the private _balances mapping.
Internal ERC20 approval helper writing directly to the _allowances mapping.
Transfer event declaration used by transferFrom and list (kept as a state-level declaration for graph completeness).
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance indexing and balance mutation.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as block.timestamp + 600 as the Uniswap liquidity deadline in list().
Unchecked low-level call to botProtection with abi.encodeWithSelector(0x15274141, ...); the boolean is required but the return data and call target behaviour are not validated.
a.delegatecall(b) with attacker-influenced target and calldata, giving full control over contract storage and balance if owner is compromised.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value executed without SafeMath on Solidity 0.7.0, allowing silent wrap-around.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 arithmetic in list() that can truncate or overflow and determines minted distribution amounts.
External call to uniRouter.addLiquidityETH forwarding msg.value and a timestamp-derived deadline before recipient balances are written.
Constructor argument of BotProtected holding the bot protection contract address.
Sender address forwarded into the botProtection low-level call by the checkBots modifier.
Recipient address forwarded into the botProtection low-level call by the checkBots modifier.
Transfer amount forwarded into the botProtection low-level call by the checkBots modifier.
Constructor argument forwarded from ShyftKycContract to the BotProtected parent constructor.
Recipient parameter of transfer(), forwarded to transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transfer(), forwarded to transferFrom.
Source address parameter of transferFrom used for allowance and balance debit.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom used for balance credit.
Amount parameter of transferFrom used in unchecked allowance/balance arithmetic.
Spender address parameter of approve used to index the allowance mapping.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Target contract address supplied to the arbitrary delegatecall.
Arbitrary calldata bytes supplied to the delegatecall.
Liquidity token amount parameter of list() written into balanceOf[address(this)].
Recipient address array parameter of list() used in the distribution loop.
Amount array parameter of list() used in the distribution loop.
Sender parameter of the internal ERC20 _transfer helper.
Recipient parameter of the internal ERC20 _transfer helper.
Amount parameter of the internal ERC20 _transfer helper.
First token address parameter used for deterministic pair derivation.
Second token address parameter used for deterministic pair derivation.
Local boolean and bytes pair capturing the success flag and return data of the botProtection low-level call.
Local variable holding the computed CREATE2 Uniswap pair address.
Loop counter used in the list() recipient distribution loop.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read in the ShyftKycContract constructor to initialize ownership.
owner state variable is assigned directly from msg.sender, defining the privileged role.
msg.sender is forwarded as _from from transfer() into transferFrom().
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping in approve().
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before performing delegatecall.
list() requires msg.sender == owner before minting and adding liquidity.
block.timestamp is used as block.timestamp + 600 deadline for addLiquidityETH, making execution miner-influenced.
_botProtection constructor parameter is used by ShyftKycContract constructor.
_botProtection is forwarded to the BotProtected parent constructor.
BotProtected constructor writes _botProtection into the botProtection state variable.
ShyftKycContract constructor calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair.
pairFor return value is stored into the uniPair state variable.
tokenA parameter drives the token ordering and hashing in pairFor.
tokenB parameter drives the token ordering and hashing in pairFor.
_from parameter indexes allowance and balanceOf in transferFrom.
_to parameter indexes balanceOf for credit in transferFrom.
_value parameter drives allowance and balance updates in transferFrom.
_from selects the storage slot that is decremented without SafeMath.
_to selects the storage slot that is incremented without SafeMath.
_value is subtracted and added on balances with no overflow check under Solidity 0.7.0.
The checkBots modifier executes an external interaction before the transferFrom body mutates balances.
The checkBots modifier forwards _from, _to, uniPair and _value into the botProtection low-level call.
transferFrom reaches the external botProtection call before debiting/crediting balanceOf, enabling reentrant state observation.
The notABot/isNotBot locals capture the result values returned by the botProtection low-level call.
_from parameter of the modifier is consumed by checkBots.
_to parameter of the modifier is consumed by checkBots.
_value parameter of the modifier is consumed by checkBots.
_from is encoded into the selector arguments of the low-level call.
_to is encoded into the selector arguments of the low-level call.
_value is encoded into the selector arguments of the low-level call.
transfer() has no logic of its own and always calls transferFrom().
_to parameter of transfer flows into its transferFrom call.
_value parameter of transfer flows into its transferFrom call.
transfer amount is passed through to transferFrom._value.
_spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
_value parameter is written into the allowance mapping in approve.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
address a parameter is used as the delegatecall target in delegate().
bytes b parameter is used as the delegatecall payload in delegate().
delegate() forwards a and b into an unrestricted delegatecall that can overwrite arbitrary storage.
Attacker-influenced target address a reaches the delegatecall operation.
list() computes totalSupply * 6 / 100 while assigning balanceOf[msg.sender].
totalSupply state variable feeds the multiplication/division arithmetic in list().
_numList parameter is used both as liquidity amount and balance assignment in list().
_tos array parameter drives the recipient distribution loop in list().
_amounts array parameter provides minted distribution values in list().
list() performs the external addLiquidityETH call forwarding msg.value before writing recipient balances.
list() writes into the balanceOf mapping for the contract and for msg.sender.
_numList is stored into balanceOf[address(this)] inside list().
Loop counter i controls iteration of the recipient distribution loop in list().
sender parameter indexes _balances in the internal ERC20 _transfer helper.
recipient parameter indexes _balances in the internal ERC20 _transfer helper.
amount parameter is used in SafeMath sub/add on _balances.
_transfer reads and writes the private _balances mapping.
_approve writes the private _allowances mapping.
Constructor grants unlimited allowances to uniRouter and to the derived uniPair before any user interaction.

normalization_plan.reason: _botProtection constructor argument only feeds the BotProtected constructor and has no independent semantics.
_from modifier parameter is consumed by checkBots and is meaningless outside the modifier.
_to modifier parameter is consumed by checkBots and is meaningless outside the modifier.
_value modifier parameter is consumed by checkBots and is meaningless outside the modifier.
_botProtection constructor argument belongs to the ShyftKycContract constructor invocation.
_to of transfer only exists as the argument of the delegation to transferFrom.
_value of transfer only exists as the argument of the delegation to transferFrom.
_from is the core input of transferFrom and has no standalone meaning.
_to is the core input of transferFrom and has no standalone meaning.
_value is the core input of transferFrom and directly drives the unsafe arithmetic.
_spender only exists to index the allowance mapping written by approve.
_value only exists to be stored by approve.
address a is the attacker-controlled target that is consumed by the delegatecall unsafe operation.
bytes b is the attacker-controlled payload passed into the delegatecall unsafe operation.
_numList only exists as a liquidity/balance argument of the owner-only list() function.
_tos is only iterated over inside list() and has no meaning outside it.
_amounts is only indexed inside the list() distribution loop.
sender is a pure argument of the internal ERC20 _transfer helper.
recipient is a pure argument of the internal ERC20 _transfer helper.
amount is a pure argument of the internal ERC20 _transfer helper.
tokenA is only used for ordering and hashing inside pairFor.
tokenB is only used for ordering and hashing inside pairFor.
notABot/isNotBot are the direct return values of the botProtection low-level call and only exist to capture its outcome.
pair is the returned value of pairFor and only exists within that computation.
i is a loop counter that exists solely for the distribution loop inside list().
